learning_outcomes.text: To get acquainted with the basics of aircraft structures, engines and astronautics for the needs of bachelor projects and bachelor's theses.

syllabus_topics: Classification of aircraft, their basic parts. Structure of wings and load transmission.
Manoeuvre and gust load factor, load factor envelope.
Load cases. Load transfer. Limit and ultimate loads.
Examples of applications of metal and composite materials.
Structural and operational problems in the space.
bibliography: Cutler J (revised by Liber J): Understanding Aircraft Structures, - fourth edition 2006, John Wiley & Sons, ISBN 978-1-405-12032-6
Anderson, J. D. (2016). Fundamentals of aerodynamics (6th ed.). Columbus, OH: McGraw-Hill Education., ISBN: 978-1-259-12991-9
Farokhi, S., Aircraft Propulsion, 2nd edition, Wiley, 2014, ISBN 978-1-118-80677-7
M. Macdonald, V.Badescu (ed.): The International Handbook of Space Technology, Springer, 2014, ISBN 978-3-642-41100-7
